title: 節約の春
source: Written by Claude (sample story, uses words from your cards)

sentences.jp: 今年の春、原油の値段が急に上がった。
sentences.en: This spring, the price of crude oil suddenly went up.

sentences.jp: ガソリン代も電気代も高くなり、私は倹約することにした。
sentences.en: Gas and electricity both got more expensive, so I decided to save money.

sentences.jp: まず、外食をやめて、毎日弁当を作った。
sentences.en: First, I stopped eating out and made a lunch box every day.

sentences.jp: 最初は面倒だったが、一か月で二万円も節約できた。
sentences.en: It was a hassle at first, but in one month I saved as much as 20,000 yen.

sentences.jp: 友達は「それは賢明な判断だね」と言ってくれた。
sentences.en: My friend said, "That was a wise decision."

sentences.jp: 今は、節約した分で日本語の本を買うのが楽しみだ。
sentences.en: Now I look forward to buying Japanese books with the money I saved.
